user.title: Connect to 17TRACK
user.description: Enter your 17TRACK API key. You can find it in your 17TRACK account under Security Setting.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the 17TRACK API.

delete_delivered_packages.name: Delete delivered packages
delete_delivered_packages.description: Deletes every package currently marked as delivered from all configured 17TRACK accounts.

delete_package.name: Delete package
delete_package.description: Deletes a single package, identified by its tag or tracking number.

identifier.name: Identifier
identifier.description: The package's tag (e.g. "Csapágy") or tracking number.

register_package.name: Register package
register_package.description: Registers a new tracking number with 17TRACK so it starts being tracked.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number to register for tracking.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Optional user-facing label for the package, shown instead of the tracking number.
